items.text: Wonke u-Israyeli wabuthana kuDavide eHebroni, wathi: “Bheka, siyithambo lakho nenyama yakho.
Futhi nasendulo, lapho uSawule eseyinkosi, nguwe owawukhipha u-Israyeli futhi ungenisa;

Ngalokho onke amalunga akwa-Israyeli eza enkosini eHebroni; uDavide wenza isivumelwano nabo eHebroni phambi kukaJehova; bamgcoba uDavide abe yinkosi phezu kuka-Israyeli njengezwi likaJehova ngesandla sikaSamuweli.
UDavide naye wonke u-Israyeli baya eJerusalema eliyiJebusi; lapho ayekhona amaJebusi, ayakhe kulelo zwe.
Abakhileyo eJebusi bathi kuDavide: “Awuyikuza lapha. Nokho, uDavide wathatha inqaba yaseSiyoni, engumuzi kaDavide.
UDavida wasesithi: Onqoba amaJebusi kuqala uzakuba yinhloko lombusi. Ngakho uJowabe indodana kaSeruya wenyuka kuqala, waba yinhloko.
UDavide wahlala enqabeni; ngalokho bawubiza ngokuthi umuzi kaDavide.
Wakha umuzi nxazonke kusukela eMilo nxazonke, uJowabe walungisa okuseleyo komuzi.
UDavide waqhubeka eba mkhulu ngokuba mkhulu, ngokuba uJehova Sebawoti wayenaye.
Laba babe yizinhloko zamaqhawe uDavide ayenazo, aziqinisa naye embusweni wakhe kanye no-Israyeli wonke ukumbeka inkosi njengezwi likaJehova ngo-Israyeli.
Lesi yisibalo samaqhawe kaDavide; uJasobham, umHagimoni, inhloko yezikhulu; waphakamisela umkhonto wakhe phezu kwamakhulu amathathu abawahlula kanyekanye.
Emva kwakhe kwakungu-Eleyazare indodana kaDodo umAhohi owayengomunye wamaqhawe amathathu.
WayenoDavide ePhasi-Damimi; amaFilisti ayebuthene khona ukulwa, lapho isiqinti sezwe sasigcwele ibhali; abantu babaleka phambi kwamaFilisti.
Bazifaka phakathi kwaleyo mpahla, bayinikela, bawabulala amaFilisti; uJehova wabakhulula ngokusindisa okukhulu.
Kwehla abathathu kwabayizikhulu ezingamashumi amathathu, baya etsheni kuDavide emhumeni wase-Adulamu; impi yamaFilisti yayikanise esigodini samaRefa.
UDavide wayesenqabeni, nempi yamaFilisti ngaleso sikhathi yayiseBetlehema.
UDavide walangazelela, wathi: “O, uma umuntu bengiyakungiphuzisa amanzi omthombo waseBetlehema ongasesangweni!
Labo abathathu bafohla impi yamaFilisti, baka amanzi emthonjeni waseBhetelehem owawusesangweni, bawathatha, bawayisa kuDavide; kepha uDavide akavumanga ukuwaphuza, wawathululela kuJehova;

wathi: “Makube kude noNkulunkulu wami ukuba ngenze lokho; ngiyakuphuza igazi lalaba bantu ababeka ukuphila kwabo engozini na? ngoba baletha ukuphila kwabo engozini. Yingakho engafuni ukuwaphuza. Lezi zinto zenza lezi zinto ezintathu ngamandla amakhulu.
U-Abishayi umfowabo kaJowabe wayeyinhloko yabathathu;
Kulaba abathathu wayetusekile kunalaba ababili; ngoba wayengumbusi wabo; kodwa akafinyelelanga kwabathathu bokuqala.
UBenaya indodana kaJoyada indodana yendoda enesibindi waseKabiseyeli, owenza izenzo eziningi; wabulala izingonyama ezimbili zakwaMowabi; wehla, wabulala ingonyama emphandwini ngosuku lweqhwa.

Wabulala nowaseGibithe, umuntu omude, eyizingalo eziyisihlanu; esandleni sowaseGibithe kwakukhona umkhonto onjengogongolo lomaluki; wehlela kuye ephethe induku, wahlwitha umkhonto esandleni sowaseGibithe, wambulala ngomkhonto wakhe.
UBenaya indodana kaJoyada wenze njalo, waba negama phakathi kwamaqhawe amathathu.
Bheka, wayetuseka phakathi kwabangamashumi amathathu, kepha akafikanga kwabathathu bokuqala; uDavide wammisa phezu kwabalindi bakhe.
Amaqhawe empi ayengo-Asaheli umfowabo kaJowabe, no-Elihanani indodana kaDodo waseBetlehema,
noSamathi umHarori, noHelesi umPheloni,
no-Ira indodana ka-Ikheki waseThekhowa, no-Abiyezeri umAntoti,
noSibegayi umHusati, no-Ilayi umAhohi,
uMaharayi umNethofa, noHeledi indodana kaBahana waseNethofa,
u-Ithayi indodana kaRibayi waseGibeya owayengowabantwana bakwaBenjamini, noBenaya umPirathoni,
Hhawu emfudlaneni waseGahashi, no-Abiyeli, no-Arbati,
no-Asmaveti umBaharumite, no-Elijaba umSahalibhoni,
Amadodana kaHashemu waseGizoni kwakunguJonathani indodana kaSage umHarari;
u-Ahiyamu indodana kaSakhari umHarari, no-Elifali indodana ka-Uri,
noHeferi umMegerati, no-Ahiya umPheloni,
noHeziro umKarmeli, noNaharayi indodana ka-Esbayi,
noJoweli umfowabo kaNathani, noMibhari indodana kaHagiri,
noSeleki umAmoni, noNaharayi umBeroti, udibi lwezikhali zikaJowabe indodana kaSeruya,
u-Ira umItri, noGarebi umItri,
u-Uriya umHeti, noZabadi indodana ka-Alayi,
u-Adina indodana kaSisa wakwaRubeni, umbusi wakwaRubeni, enamashumi amathathu naye,
uHanani, indodana kaMaga, noJehoshafati, umMithini,
u-Uziya wase-Astera, noShama, noJehiyeli, amadodana kaHothani umArori,
uJediyayeli indodana kaZimri, noJoha umfowabo umThishi,
u-Eliyeli umMahavi, noJeribayi, noJosaviya, amadodana ka-Elinahama, no-Ima umMowabi,
o-Eliyeli, no-Obede, noJasiyeli, abaseMesoba.
